subject M4 ruled: pin the loudness rule on both branches; walkthrough suite green (42)
The held test was RED against a CORRECT CLI. Root cause found: the
_supplement_borrow_glosses helper (added earlier this campaign) declares a
concepts entry for every borrow, so a contract-built module always declares
concepts and the quiet branch became unreachable. Quiet branch now uses a
raw fixture with the required justification; loud branch pinned separately
because it is actionable. Each pin fails loudly if its fixture goes stale.

subject WIP gen-12 fixes: restart-on-repeat chain policy, arity-aware declaration check
NOT YET GROUP-REVIEWED. Two of three builders reported; each is
individually RED-first pinned and suite-green (phase_1 863 passed,
test_repair 44, test_checks 34). Committed to clear the tree for the PR #3
merge, not as acceptance -- the group adversarial review and the
prior-success/prior-failure validation run still gate these.

Chain policy: repeat-of-any-earlier-reply stops the chain and restarts once
from a clean transcript (29/29 lost chains caught vs 27/29 for adjacent
identity); frozen flag on refreeze; estimate_cost now prices the doubled
worst case (it would have printed 50% low against a hard ledger cap).
Arity check: declaration comparison is arity-aware in checks.py, emitted as
origin=schema so DISCLOSABLE_ORIGINS actually shows it to the repair prompt;
schema.py residual proposed, not applied.
